overview: Single independent component with no dependencies, so it is built in a single phase.

phases.name: Foundation Service
phases.description: The sole todo-api service has no dependencies and implements all required functionality.

components.name: todo-api
responsibilities: Expose REST endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting todos
Validate input and return consistent JSON error responses
Persist todos to a JSON file and load on startup
Ensure concurrency safety via RWMutex over in-memory map
Provide health check and request/error logging
components.architectureContext: Standalone HTTP service on port 9090 serving clients directly; no upstream/downstream services. Reads/writes local JSON file for persistence.
keyConsiderations: Use sync.RWMutex to protect in-memory map and file writes
Persist on every write; load or create file at startup (TODO_DATA_FILE env, default /data/todos.json)
Panic recovery middleware returning 500 INTERNAL_ERROR without leaking details
Use google/uuid for IDs and RFC3339 UTC timestamps
Multi-stage Dockerfile, EXPOSE 9090, ensure /data directory exists
components.apiContract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: {type: string}
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List todos
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of todos
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
    post:
      summary: Create todo
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateTodoRequest'}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'}
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
  /todos/{id}:
    delete:
      summary: Delete todo
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '204': {description: Deleted}
        '404':
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'}
components:
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: {type: string}
        title: {type: string}
        completed: {type: boolean}
        createdAt: {type: string, format: date-time}
    CreateTodoRequest:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: {type: string, maxLength: 255}
        completed: {type: boolean}
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        error: {type: string}
        code: {type: string}
